content.overview: Section 135 requires a CSR committee and spending of at least 2 per cent of average net profits where the net-worth, turnover or profit threshold is met.
content.glance: Section 135 requires a CSR committee and spending of at least 2 per cent of average net profits where the net-worth, turnover or profit threshold is met.
content.study: The thresholds are net worth of five hundred crore rupees, turnover of one thousand crore, or net profit of five crore during the immediately preceding financial year. Average net profit is of the three preceding years, computed under s. 198. Unspent amounts follow the ongoing-project and transfer rules inserted by later amendments. Schedule VII activities qualify. The board report must disclose reasons for not spending.
